title: EUUKAITARY WLF15 Fingerprint Smart Door Lock w/ WiFi

comparisons.notes: New silver; SKU AZB0DYJN7XRK = ASIN B0DYJN7XRK; EUUKAITARY WLF15 fingerprint WiFi handle lock; in stock qty 100

writeup: Woot has a new EUUKAITARY WLF15 fingerprint and WiFi door lock in silver for $44.99. It unlocks in about 0.3 seconds and connects over built-in WiFi, so no hub is required. Venue Marketplace currently lists the same silver model (SKU AZB0DYJN7XRK) at $92 and shows 100 in stock. That is 51 percent and about $47 below Venue Marketplace. Quantity is 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
